items.contentSnippet:
A calm, local-first desktop PDF reader designed to make sure you remember what you read. You can link notes across files and group notes/annotations into a larger Markdown note, which can be linked with others.
The Releases are only for Windows, but you can use the code to build for any system Tauri Supports (Linux- Debian or macOS).
It's fast and small in size and has first-class support for annotations and note-taking.

items.title: Show HN: Clippety – Private video clipping in the browser
items.contentSnippet:
Hi I'm Per, the author of Clippety!
I wanted a way to turn videos into clips formatted for social media. But the solutions I found forced me to upload the source video which I did not want to do for privacy reasons.
So I made Clippety, which reframes, creates captions and adds a search against the transcript so you can easily find and create clips 100% private in your browser.
Works best in Chrome on desktop right now, but it's still a work in progress.
Unlimited usage/exports with a watermark.
